name: Pragmatic Park FlexLogic-002 fab

process_nodes.label: FlexIC Platform Gen 3
process_nodes.note: Metal-oxide thin-film transistor technology for flexible mixed-signal ASICs. The platform was announced with manufacturing at Pragmatic Park in March 2025; the technology brief specifies a 600 nm minimum channel dimension, not a silicon CMOS node designation.

summary: Pragmatic announced FlexLogic-002 at its new Durham site in March 2022 and opened the 300 mm fab at Pragmatic Park in March 2024. The foundry makes flexible integrated circuits using metal-oxide thin-film transistors. Its Gen 3 platform launched in March 2025 with manufacturing at this site. A September 2026 company update reported that high-volume manufacturing had ramped and that the company was expanding capacity. The record covers the named fab, with the broader park kept separate from its production scope.

metrics.note: Area of the Pragmatic Park brownfield site, including room for future lines; not the cleanroom area of FlexLogic-002.

milestones.note: FlexLogic-002 was announced for the new Pragmatic Park site.
